title: HytaleCrossplay
description: Easy way to crossplay between Hytale and Minecraft
body:
# HytaleCrossplay
## How does this project work?
Inside of the minecraft server, it creates a Hytale server and replicates everything between eachother.
STILL WORK IN PROGRESS, MANY FEATURES ARE MISSING.
## How do I use this?
Put the plugin in your plugins folder, start the server, wait for java 25 to download and extract and then it will give you a prompt for a Hytale login. You need to use the link to login, else you aren't able to download the Hytale Server Software.
After the download finished, it will automatically run the Hytale Server Software. To authenticate the server, enter this in chat:
```
/hysudo auth login device
```
After that, check console and press the link which popped up. When you finished the authorization you will also be able to join from Hytale.
If you want to not need to authenticate on every join, enter this command:
```
/hysudo auth persistence Encrypted
```
## Commands
Currently, theres only 1 command and it requires you to be on console and to be opped.
- ``hysudo`` - Sends command in the Hytale Server
  ```
  /hysudo <Command>
  ```
